messages.author: Alessandro Contini
messages.body:
Hi all,
does anybody knows if the "anti-mining flag" (LHR) NVIDIA recently added to the RTX cards would affect pmemd.cuda performance? Preventing draining GPU stocks is a good thing, since I'm having troubles in finding a couple of cards from standard suppliers (the only channels I can use for purchasing through the university), but I'm worried that this could also brake our toy...
Thanks
Alessandro
